text: This report responds to the Board recommendation from Item EP15.3 in February 2025 where the Board directed staff to provide a letter of support to tenants and event organizers at Exhibition Place for events held between May 1 and September 30, to be considered as Municipally Significant to apply for a Special Occasion Permit or a temporary extension of premises and/or hours for the sale of alcohol at permanently licensed locations, and staff report back annually to the Board on the Nighttime Economy - Municipally Significant Designation. Exhibition Place is Canada’s most extensive entertainment venue, hosting more than 2,000 events and attracting over 6 million visitors annually. This iconic entertainment, music, and events site is pivotal in Toronto’s cultural and economic fabric, generating over $594 million in annual economic impact. The Board of Governors of Exhibition Place: 1. Directed the Chief Executive Officer to continue to provide letters of support to tenants for late-night extended hours corporate and entertainment events held at tenanted facilities, expressing the economic and tourism significance, in support of their application for a temporary extension of operating hours to sell alcohol at licensed locations.
